claims: Andrej Stojaković is a basketball player for the Illinois Fighting Illini.
Andrej Stojaković is the son of Peja Stojaković.
Peja Stojaković is a three-time NBA All-Star.
Peja Stojaković is a 2011 NBA champion with the Dallas Mavericks.
Peja Stojaković has been spotted attending Illinois Fighting Illini games to support his son.
Peja Stojaković's Serbian name is Предраг "Пеђа" Стојаковић.
Peja Stojaković played 13 seasons for the Kings, Pacers, Hornets, Raptors, Mavericks.
Peja Stojaković is a 2-time Three-Point Shootout champion.
Peja Stojaković is married to Aleka Kamila.
Aleka Kamila is a Greek model.
Aleka Kamila is a former high jumper.
Peja Stojaković has expressed pride in Andrej Stojaković’s journey through American high school and college basketball.
Commentators noted Andrej Stojaković's inherited shooting ability.
